steps.label: Projekt entpacken
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && cat g_v1_aa g_v1_ab g_v1_ac > film.tgz && cat h_v4_aa h_v4_ab h_v4_ac > mix.m4a && [ "$(md5 -q film.tgz)" = 0908aefe5263da9ec35af356cfc707bf ] && [ "$(md5 -q mix.m4a)" = 7d637b50007ce44c394a5fb03ac228a1 ] && rm -rf src public && tar xzf film.tgz && ls public | wc -l

steps.label: Video rendern
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && s=$(date +%s) && npx remotion render src/index.jsx P out.mp4 --gl=angle --crf=18 --muted --concurrency=6 --timeout=180000 --log=error && e=$(date +%s) && echo "render_seconds $((e-s))" > render_time.txt

steps.label: Ton anlegen
steps.run: cd "$AGENT_HOME/pilot_test/film" && npx remotion ffmpeg -y -v error -i out.mp4 -i mix.m4a -map 0:v -map 1:a -c copy -shortest peloton_film1.mp4 && ls -la peloton_film1.mp4 >> render_time.txt
